methodHandling.otherMethods: Any other method (PUT, HEAD, OPTIONS...) -> 405 {"error":"GET, POST, PATCH or DELETE only"}, but only AFTER requireUser succeeds (unauthenticated PUT gets 401, not 405).

auth.notes: Runs first for every method. Bearer = Supabase JWT, or DEV_SECRET_KEY bypass mapping to DEV_USER_ID. Auxi_Connector calls with its own service bearer (settings.slide_forge_token, forge_brands.py:195-199); which identity that resolves to (dev bypass or a real Supabase user) is not visible from code (unverified). All Connector-created brands therefore belong to that single identity.

query.name: id
query.invalidBehaviour: missing/empty -> 400 'id required'; a non-UUID string reaches Postgres (uuid column) -> PostgrestError thrown -> 500 {"error":"Internal error"} (deleteBrandRow does not UUID-guard, unlike getBrandAccess)

query.name: (any)
query.parse: GET/POST/PATCH ignore the query string entirely

request.parse: POST/PATCH: `await req.json().catch(() => null)`; malformed JSON, empty body, or a falsy JSON value (null, 0, false, "") -> 400 {"error":"Invalid JSON body"}. A truthy non-object (e.g. 5, "x", []) passes and then fails field validation (name -> 400 name message; PATCH -> 400 'brandId is required').

fields.name: name
fields.validation: typeof string && trim() non-empty && trim().length <= 120, else 400 'name is required (1-120 characters)'; stored trimmed

fields.name: kit
fields.bounds: JSON.stringify(kit).length <= 262144 chars (256*1024), checked on UTF-16 string length, not bytes
fields.validation: If present: any own key in {logoKey, masterKey, titleMasterKey, dividerMasterKey, furnitureKey} (even with value null) -> 400 '<key> cannot be set on create — upload the asset first, then PATCH'. Then sanitizeKitPatch (see kitFieldRules). kit: null or a non-object -> 400 'kit must be an object'.

fields.name: brandId
fields.validation: typeof string && non-empty else 400 'brandId is required'. Non-UUID strings -> getBrandAccess returns null -> 404 'Brand not found'.

fields.name: name
fields.validation: only validated when !== undefined; name: null -> 400 'name is required (1-120 characters)'

fields.name: kit
fields.validation: sanitizeKitPatch(kit, existing.ownerId, brandId); then SHALLOW merge over stored kit; a null value deletes that key from the stored kit. kit: {} is accepted and counts as an update (rewrites kit + updated_at).

kitFieldRules.nullValue: any key with value null is accepted without validation (even unknown keys!) and becomes 'delete this key' in PATCH; on POST the null is stored literally in the kit jsonb (brands.ts:49)
kitFieldRules.blobKeyFields: logoKey->logo, masterKey->master, titleMasterKey->titleMaster, dividerMasterKey->dividerMaster: any truthy value accepted, stored as canonical 'brand/<ownerId>/<brandId>/<kind>.png' (never the sent string). Falsy non-null (false, 0, "") -> 400 '<key> must be a truthy value or null'. The server does NOT check that the blob exists.
kitFieldRules.furnitureKey: truthy -> stored as 'brand/<ownerId>/<brandId>/furniture.json'; falsy non-null -> 400 'furnitureKey must be a truthy value or null'
kitFieldRules.furnitureArchetypes: array whose every element is 'cover'|'divider'|'content' (empty array OK) else 400 'furnitureArchetypes must be an array of "cover" | "divider" | "content"'
kitFieldRules.hexFields: primaryColor, accentColor, neutralColor: /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/ else 400 '<key> must be a hex color like #1A2B3C'
kitFieldRules.stringFields: company, headingFont, bodyFont, styleTemplate: typeof string (no length cap, empty allowed) else 400 '<key> must be a string'
kitFieldRules.passthroughFields: layouts, workzone, typographyScale, masterDecorations, logoShapes, allColors, headingPlaceholders, archetypeLayouts: stored verbatim, no validation (normalizeKit re-validates on read)
kitFieldRules.unknownField: any other non-null key -> 400 'Unknown kit field: <key>' (first offending key in object iteration order; whole request rejected)

request.unknownFields: Top-level body: unknown keys ignored. Inside kit: unknown non-null keys rejected 400 'Unknown kit field: <key>'; unknown keys with null value silently accepted.

checkOrder: POST: 3. JSON parse (400 Invalid JSON body) 4. name (400) 5. blob-key-on-create scan (400) 6. sanitizeKitPatch (400) 7. insertBrand
PATCH: 3. JSON parse 4. brandId (400) 5. getBrandAccess -> 404 / 403 6. name (400) 7. sanitizeKitPatch (400) 8. 'Nothing to update' (400) 9. updateBrandRow 10. re-read via getBrandAccess

responses.notes: Org brands reachable via the caller's verified email domain come FIRST, then personal brands ordered updated_at DESC. Org brands' order is unspecified (no .order). Empty: {"brands":[]}.
No isOrg key on the create response (insertBrand selects id,name,kit only), unlike GET/PATCH.
If the row disappeared between update and re-read, body is the JSON literal null with status 200 (`updated && {...}`).

responses.when: always when id present and a valid UUID: owner-scoped, idempotent; deleting a non-existent, someone else's, or an ORG brand is a silent no-op

errors.when: POST/PATCH body unparsable or falsy JSON
POST missing/blank/too-long name; PATCH name present but invalid

body.error: <key> cannot be set on create — upload the asset first, then PATCH

errors.when: POST kit contains logoKey|masterKey|titleMasterKey|dividerMasterKey|furnitureKey (any value). Note em dash U+2014.
kit is null, array, or a primitive

body.error: <key> must be a truthy value or null

errors.when: blob-key field with falsy non-null value (PATCH)

body.error: furnitureKey must be a truthy value or null
furnitureArchetypes must be an array of "cover" | "divider" | "content"
<key> must be a hex color like #1A2B3C

errors.when: kit key outside the allow-list with non-null value
PATCH: brand unreachable (non-UUID, absent, someone else's personal brand, org brand not granted to caller's domain)

body.error: Organization brands can only be edited by an admin

errors.when: PATCH by a non-admin domain member of an org brand

body.error: Nothing to update — provide name and/or kit

errors.when: PATCH with neither name nor kit (em dash U+2014)

body.error: GET, POST, PATCH or DELETE only

errors.when: any Supabase/PostgREST error (e.g. DELETE ?id=not-a-uuid, DB outage)

sideEffects: POST: inserts brands row {user_id: caller, name, kit} via service-role client (db.ts:263-271)

PATCH: updates name and/or kit + updated_at (db.ts:286-292). For org brands edited by an admin, canonical blob keys use the brand OWNER id, not the editor (brands.ts:128; _tests/brands.test.ts:123-127)
DELETE: deletes personal brand row owned by caller (is_org=false). Blobs are NOT deleted (db.ts:294-296)
externalCalls: Supabase (service role) only; no paid APIs
quirks: The 20-personal-brand cap exists only in the RLS insert policy (supabase/migrations/0005_brands.sql:18-22, 0011_org_domain_brands.sql:109-117); POST /api/brands inserts with the service-role client, which bypasses RLS, so the API path has NO brand cap.
POST response has no isOrg; GET and PATCH responses do.
GET returns the raw stored kit (no normalizeKit), so whatever PATCH stored (incl. passthrough garbage) is echoed back.
null kit values bypass all validation, including for unknown keys; on POST they are stored as literal nulls.
Blob-key fields are canonicalized server-side; sending `true` is the documented idiom. The asset need not exist.

DELETE never returns 404; org brands cannot be deleted here (silent 200 no-op). Auxi_Connector's delete_brand treats 404 as 'already gone' (forge_brands.py:256) - a branch this handler never produces.
DELETE with a non-UUID id is a 500, not 400/200.
Kit size limit measured as JS string length of JSON.stringify, not bytes.
PATCH 404 vs 403 split: unreachable -> 404 (indistinguishable from not found); reachable read-only org brand -> 403.
PATCH validates name/kit only after the access check, so a bad kit on someone else's brand yields 404, not 400.
Frontend does NOT call this route: the web app reads/writes the brands table directly through Supabase RLS (src/lib/brands.ts:26-65). Only Auxi_Connector uses /api/brands.
beforeAnyState: GET with no brands -> 200 {"brands":[]}. PATCH on a non-existent brand -> 404 'Brand not found'. DELETE on a non-existent brand -> 200 {"ok":true}.

tests.asserts: GET lists ({brands:[{id,name,kit}]}); POST 201 + validated kit; POST 400 missing name / bad hex / unknown kit field (error contains key) / blob-key on create (error contains 'masterKey'); PATCH shallow merge, blob-key canonicalization, null deletes, bad furnitureArchetypes 400, 404 not-owned, 403 read-only org member, admin edit keyed under owner, 400 nothing to update; DELETE {ok:true} and 400 without id; 405 on PUT

callers.expects: POST {name[:120], kit} -> any status <400, reads resp.json()['id']; kit carries colours/fonts/workzone only because blob keys are rejected on create

PATCH {brandId, kit?, name?}; success = status <400 (body ignored). Relies on shallow merge and truthy blob-key activation; its _KIT_FIELDS allow-list (forge_brands.py:332-346) exists because PATCH 400s the WHOLE request on one unknown key (observed 'Unknown kit field: layoutPreviews')
GET -> dict with list 'brands' whose items have 'id'; >=400 or malformed = unknown

docs.openapi: public/openapi.yaml:1235-1338. Discrepancies: (1) GET described as 'All brands owned by the caller' but also returns domain-granted org brands, and items carry isOrg which components.schemas.Brand (openapi.yaml:219-228) lacks; (2) BrandKitData (230-279) omits accepted passthrough fields layouts, workzone, typographyScale, masterDecorations, logoShapes, allColors, headingPlaceholders, archetypeLayouts; (3) PATCH 403 (org brand, non-admin) and 400s undocumented; POST 400s undocumented; (4) DELETE says owner-scoped no-op but does not mention org brands are undeletable here or that non-UUID id is 500; (5) no 405 documented.
docs.apiMd: docs/api.md:704-824. api.md:700 claims a 20-brand personal cap; not enforced on this API path (service role bypasses RLS).

planSection65: Row: '/api/brands (GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE) | GET -> {brands}; POST {name, kit?} -> 201 brand; PATCH {brandId, name?, kit?}; DELETE'. Accurate but incomplete: DELETE takes ?id= (query, not body) and returns {ok:true}; PATCH returns {id,name,kit,isOrg}; POST 201 body lacks isOrg; frontend is not a caller (Supabase direct) - Auxi_Connector is the only caller.
